array.string: exec /opt/homebrew/bin/cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:8090 --no-autoupdate --protocol http2 2>&1 | tee -a data/cloudflared.log | grep --line-buffered -o 'https://[a-z0-9-]*\.trycloudflare\.com' | grep --line-buffered -v '^https://api\.' | while read u; do echo "$u" > data/public_url.txt; done
